title: Class ranking
summary: Load NAME GRADE records into an array of structs, sort them with qsort and print a numbered list and the average.
hints: `struct student { char name[32]; double grade; };` in an array that grows with `realloc`. Read each line with `fgets` and `sscanf(line, "%31s %lf", s.name, &s.grade)`.
The comparison function for `qsort` returns the order by grade (bigger first) and, if equal, `strcmp` of the names. The average needs all the grades, so add them while loading.
